name: Hekaton
_notes: Transcribed from card scans (sheet AU0447, AI AR0394-AR0413, BP AS0415-AS0432).

Icon key: ⟁(flower) = Escalations at start of Battle, ⊚ = AT bonus, ◆ = Evasion dice bonus, Λ = Danger bonus (bonusPerHit: 'for each hit' on Lv5+). Lv0 AT -1; Lv3 Escalation 1 + Danger +1; Lv4 Escalation 2, AT +1, Danger +1, Evasion +1.
BP cards also carry a resource-type icon top-right (two variants); not transcribed yet - verify against rulebook p.46-53.
Sheet bottom-left: 2x2 footprint, R R = rear spaces along top edge; arrow-5 icon (base pushback/knockback? TBC).

'⚡ ' prefix on a step = Window of Opportunity (the diamond-! icon on the card) before that instruction; afterWindow = the After Attack section also opens a window. Lines without the prefix belong to the preceding block.
BP responses: '⚡ ' before Knockback/Knockdown = Window of Opportunity (◆! on the card).
_levelNotes: Traits are cumulative (+all previous). 'rightColumn' = the +3 / +12 value with the mound-like icon on levels III/IV (meaning TBC). 'bonusPerHit' = sheet says 'for each hit'.

traits.Friendly Warning: -2 to all Knockbacks performed by the Hekaton.
traits.Clever Boy: Board Edges gain Boundless: they are now high cliffs. If a Titan is moved beyond the edge, they die.
traits.A Fist for a Fist: Each time the Hekaton gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds) place a token on this Trait. If there are 3 or more tokens on this Trait, finish resolving the current action, discard all tokens, then perform Signature.
traits.Fleet of Hands: +1 to all Pushbacks and +2 to all Knockbacks performed by the Hekaton.
traits.Fissures: Additional Setup: Alternate Battle Diagram. If you are playing an Ambush Battle, replace the Labyrinth tiles with Maze Fissure tiles of the corresponding size and shape.
traits.Scourge of the Centimanes: All BP cards without a Wound Response gain: WOUND: Pushback 3. All BP cards without a Fail Response gain: FAIL: Knockback 5.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Starfish: Start of Primordial Round: If the Hekaton is adjacent to 2 or more Titans, all of those Titans suffer Knockback 5.
traits.A Wall of Fists: Titans cannot voluntarily move into spaces adjacent to the Hekaton.
traits.Supersonic Punch: If you are pushed into an Obstacle, you die. Additional setup: Alternate Battle Diagram (see Mnestis Battle Diagrams).
traits.Megaton: After End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).

FRONT: Closest Titan in front, in range
PRIORITY_FRONT: Closest Titan in front, in range

ai.name: Furious Smash
steps: Each hit deals 1 DANGER. | FATE 4+: 2 DANGER instead

ai.name: Chainfist

ai.name: Suckerpunch
steps: Each hit deals 2 DANGER. | FATE 5+: 3 DANGER instead

ai.name: Solarplexar
ai.after: If 2+ DANGER was dealt, draw a Kratos card.

ai.name: Death from a Hundred Fists
steps: Roll as many additional Evasion Dice as there are hits. Repeat until there are no hits. Then each hit deals 1 DANGER. | FATE 6+: 2 DANGER instead

ai.name: Thunderclash
steps: Each hit deals 3 DANGER. | FATE 6+: 4 DANGER instead

ai.name: Backbreaker
steps: FATE 8+: You Die. If you didn't die, each hit deals 2 DANGER, then draw an Obol instead of a regular Trauma Draw.

ai.name: Solarsuplexar
ai.after: If DANGER was dealt, draw a Kratos card.

ai.name: Cow Toss
ai.text: Furthest Titan suffers Knockdown, raises DANGER to 9 and draws an Obol. Hekaton moves adjacent to the Closest Titan with Unlimited Speed.

bp.name: The Runt
bp.critical: During the second ability window place 2 additional Opening or Break tokens in the Kratos Pool.

bp.name: Right Shield Fist
bp.critical: Until the end of Battle, when attacked from a Rear space, the Hekaton has -1 PRECISION.

bp.name: Left Shield Fist
bp.critical: Gain 1 Ancient Shell Rare resource. You may perform a Bonus Attack!

bp.name: Knuckle Teeth

responses.FAIL: Gain DANGER equal to the Primordial LVL.

bp.critical: Gain the Priority Target token. You may perform a Bonus Attack!

bp.name: Humanity
